justification: The [original proof](https://math.stackexchange.com/questions/1610806/bound-on-the-size-of-permutation-set-for-isomorphism) assumes β≤n³ although the claim does not. Concretely, G=H=K₆⊔K₁, partitioned into its components, permits β₁=S₆ and β₂={id}. The identity satisfies the required isomorphism condition, but β=720>7³=343. This admissible case is excluded without justification or subsequent treatment—a genuine gap distinct from the ground truth’s block-mixing defect.
